parsed.main_gap: The crucial tree-component argument establishing Lemma 4 is asserted without proof.

errors.description: Lemma 4’s central combinatorial step is omitted. The write-up must show that the pairing multigraph has an acyclic component and that a bipartite signing makes paired contributions cancel up to their slacks, including the possible unpaired part.
errors.quote: By a tree-component argument on the multigraph whose vertices are the original pieces $0,1,\dots,n$ and whose edges are the pairs $P_i$, there is a set $V_T\subseteq\{0,\dots,n\}$ and signs $s:V_T\to\{\pm1\}$ such that the signed sum $\Xi:=\sum_{j\in V_T}s(j)\,q_j$ satisfies $|\Xi|\le\sum_i\varepsilon_i+[M\text{ odd}]\,a_M$ (standard; details omitted).

parsed.notes: The picking-game reduction and upper-bound construction are convincing. The missing lower-bound argument is essential but appears repairable in a short, precise graph-theoretic paragraph.
